vetSays.line: A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.

🛡️ A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with 8L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose telling A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the stone pile instead.
🪨 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (2 stone now.)
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek sets out to find Kate. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek telling Macarena about herself. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
"Enough," A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek says. "I want a say in how this village runs. A real say."
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
🪨 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (3 stone now.)
🚶 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek is back — found Kate.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 60s telling A man, maybe 40s about A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Macarena telling Desmond about A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Better close to the fire today.
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Got it," A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek says flatly. "Orders are orders. Whoever gives them."
"Why are YOU giving orders?" A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
🛡️ August, Kate, Luis, Katarina and Farid met them at the door — 5 put down. August, Kate, Luis, Katarina, Farid are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luis just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Macarena, Luis, Farid and Elena met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Macarena, Luis, Farid, Elena are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Poppy just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Poppy just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Poppy and Rustem met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Poppy, Rustem are hurt.
